name: frontend-rooting-from-repo-base
body:
Every frontend's package/module identity must be derived from the repository-relative base, never from the basename of the checkout directory it happens to be running in, and no source file may be emitted under two module identities. Concretely: a TS repo must not synthesise a root module named after the checkout (e.g. `ts.cosanima-1.0.0` or `ts.fix-module-identity`) merely because build outputs live outside the named packages, and a file inside a named workspace package must be emitted once, under that package, not also under the recursive synthetic root.

Acceptance criteria:
- A scan of a worktree contains no module whose name is the worktree/checkout directory basename.
- Each source file appears under exactly one module identity.
- A file shared by two worktrees has the same module identity in both graphs.
